<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD defines a standard build process for the `pipeweaver-app` package, which is a Qt-based wrapper for the Pipeweaver UI. The source is fetched from the official GitHub repository (`https://github.com/pipeweaver/pipeweaver`) using a tagged release archive, and the sha512 checksum is provided and matches the expected value, ensuring source integrity.

The build process uses standard Rust tooling (`cargo fetch`, `cargo build`) with appropriate flags like `--locked`, `--frozen`, and `--release`, which ensure dependency consistency and prevent unexpected network fetches during build. The `prepare()` and `build()` functions appropriately set environment variables such as `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, which are common in Rust-based AUR packages.

The `package()` function installs the compiled binary and desktop file to standard system directories without performing any suspicious file operations, network requests, or system modifications. There are no uses of `eval`, `base64`, or obfuscated commands, and no evidence of data exfiltration or unauthorized remote execution. The package depends only on `pipeweaver` and `qt6-webengine`, both of which are relevant to the application's purpose. All actions align with standard AUR packaging practices for a Rust/Qt application.
</details>
